text_block_list.text: Day of Satsuki Sho ——

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Rare for you to come watch someone else's 
race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
…Felt like I had to come see today's 
Satsuki Sho…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oooh～! Must be divine revelation bestowed upon you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Maybe something will lead us to even 
greater fortunes…! So exciting…!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be Mejiro Bright's win! Following 
last year's momentum, race is in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold's smallest again～ Looks like 
tough race for her…

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
…Really want her to shock everyone today 
with her running.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Agreed, though even if she can't, that's 
how racing goes sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All we can do is watch Stego's Classic 
debut and pray no bad luck hits her.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …Hitting me now…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: That I'm actually running today…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: In Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahah… Been a while since I got chills like this…!

Seeing Stay Gold's raw excitement for 
Satsuki Sho made my heart skip beat.
choice_data_list: Show everyone what you're made of
Show everyone what you're made of

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's take bold first step into 
uncharted territory.
——Someone sounds eager.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh～ You guys! Geez, came all this way for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In your words, this race is departure for 
your journey ahead. Only natural I see my 
training partner off, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant Chestnut-Haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
$(scale 55)Lady Stego, best of luck…! I 
may only watch from sidelines, but I shall 
pray for your win…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Taking those prayers with me onto 
turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
…Bright and others aim for flawless 
victory. Won't be easy race, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's Classic for reason. Naturally, 
I'm ready.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely, everyone. Giving it 
everything I got.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Alright. Time to get going.
choice_data_list: May you have a good Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Have great Satsuki Sho too!
(Waaaaaaaaaahーーーーー!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …So this is Satsuki Sho paddock…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(…Can feel crowd's excitement and dreams 
swirling all around…)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …Just soaking this in feels great.
Miss Stego～

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Glad we could meet at Satsuki Sho without 
issue.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Feeling all kinds of things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let us make this fine race. I will not 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
On my Mejiro family pride, I shall not 
lose to you, Miss Stego, or anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Honored you see me like that, Bright… 
Let's make this good Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed. See you after race ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (…Bright's resolve is real deal. But ——)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(…Storm brewing on this turf, and not just 
for Bright. Actually, don't even know who 
it's for…)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Well, if they're not running today, fated 
to clash eventually anyway ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ——Bring it on, I'll take on anything.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let this storm settle it all in Satsuki 
Sho…!
